posts.text: Great conversation with @reclaimingwithmonica ❤️ Of course you should always be open to feedback and constructive criticism & you never want to become “tone deaf” or delusional … however … too many seek validation and self worth through the opinions of others and that is a formula that’s leading to a lot of anxiety and unhappiness .. at the end of the day .. you can’t live life like you’re still in middle school … you have to be happy with your moves not if the crowd agrees with it.. in fact .. most of the best things you’ll do won’t be understood by those around you … ❤️

Once you master this … the sky 🌌 is the limit … so many of you fear rejection (which triggers your insecurities ) that you end up not “living” ‼️ Please share this with someone in your inner circle ⭕️ that needs it #lifeadvice #garyvee #rejection
Don't let your past relationship effect your future ones. #lifeadvice #perspective #garyvee

Bosses and leaders around the world 🌍 should really take a step back and get serious about their "expectations" of employees .. you want results, but are you really thinking about what you can do for them instead of the other way around? Too much entitlement on the ownership level .. Yes, you pay people, but if you add some humanity and care ❤️ along with a paycheck 💵 you'd be shocked how much better your business would be! #bosses#leadership#advice

Hard to be upset about judgement when you realize this truth and even more wonderful .. it stops you in your tracks to the judgement you deploy on others …. Read this twice … it could save your happiness ❤️♥️

No excuses !!!! It’s out there for you …. I know y’all can do it … don’t let anyone tell you otherwise … the people and energies around you that are saying “No” “You cant” “it won’t happen” are projecting… believe in yourself and put in the work, deploy the humility and the patience .. Just start
Kids need consequences, ramifications, boundaries.. kids need to learn how to lose... teaching them these things is different than being too critical on them and not listening to them.
I need you to listen this morning … like really listen 👂 … please share this with someone’s who’s scared to share … please 🙏 #lifeadvice #perspective #garyvee

posts.text: Have you ever zoned out on a Zoom call, then realised you’ve missed the last two minutes? I’ve been trying Wispr Flow’s Notetaker, which records and transcribes meetings in real time. You can ask it what you missed, search previous meetings for specific decisions, and use the transcripts with tools like ChatGPT and Claude to draft follow-up emails or messages. Very useful if, like me, you spend a lot of time in meetings, and even more time trying to remember what actually happened in them.  It’s currently available on Mac and Windows, and the Notetaker is free to use. Copy the link for one month of Wispr Flow Pro for free: https://ref.wisprflow.ai/ali_tiktok_notetaker

People probably don’t want what you’re selling because they either think your product or service can help them solve their painful problem or they can’t afford it. If you’re trying to sell them the vehicle that helps them get to where they want to be, sometimes it’s really hard to get them to see the value, because they want a tangible outcome.

We've got a few hundred students in Lifestyle Business Academy now, all professionals starting their first online business. As you'd imagine, the outcomes are all over the place. Some of them are absolutely crushing it. Others have been with us for months and have barely got started. I've been thinking a lot about what actually separates the two. I reckon it comes down to three things. 1️⃣ First, the niche. Almost all of our most successful students picked something they already had skills or a network in. 2️⃣ Second, imperfect action.
